sn45.27:1.2: “Bhikkhus, just as a pot without a stand is easily knocked over, while one with a stand is difficult to knock over,
sn45.27:1.3: so the mind without a stand is easily knocked over, while the mind with a stand is difficult to knock over.
sn45.27:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the stand of the mind?
sn45.27:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.27:1.7: This is the stand of the mind.
sn45.27:1.9: so the mind without a stand is easily knocked over, while the mind with a stand is difficult to knock over.”
